| Year | Independent incidents | Team call‑outs | Volunteer hours | Fatalities |

**Sources**

* 2021 Statistics Report – “Scottish Mountain Rescue member teams attended **660 independent incidents** (497 in 2020). The total number of separate team call‑outs was **951** (715 in 2020). SMR team members volunteered **31 799 hours** … There were **19 fatalities**…” – 2021 report PDF: <https://www.scottishmountainrescue.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/SMR_Statistics_Report_2021_v3_pages-FINAL.pdf>.

The other years (2019, 2020, 2022, 2023) do not simultaneously meet all four thresholds. 2019 had > 500 incidents but only 672 call‑outs (below 800) and 14 fatalities (below 25) while 2020 had fewer than 500 incidents. 2022 had slightly under 30 000 volunteer hours, and 2023 had 41 fatalities (above 25). Thus, 2021 is the unique year that meets every criterion.
